name: Christmas Trick Star!
original_name: クリスマストリックスター!
source:
“Fucking Merry Christmas”
“Umm… Who are you?”
“Santa Claus”
“And my present is…?”
“Lead”

Naughty boy Yuusuke’s life changed after Bell the crimson Santa crashed through his window and pointed a gun at him. This is a silly and happy love story, which also ropes in his perverted childhood friend Tamaki. Will this year’s Christmas be black or white?

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2015/12/18/december-2015-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
“该死的圣诞快乐”
“嗯……你是谁？”
“圣诞老人”
“我的礼物是……？”
“领导”

当深红色的圣诞老人贝尔冲破窗户并用枪指着顽皮男孩雄介时，他的生活发生了变化。这是一个愚蠢而幸福的爱情故事，也与他变态的青梅竹马环有关。今年的圣诞节是黑色还是白色？

[来自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2015/12/18/december-2015-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri！[/url]]
